Portugal

Algarve, Faro
Algarve Coast Cliffside Courses Family Friendly

Golf in Portugal

The Algarve pairs dramatic, cliffside coastal courses with a well-established tourism infrastructure that makes it one of the easiest golf destinations to plan a family-friendly trip around. Courses here range from tight, technical layouts to wide resort courses suited to higher handicaps.

Faro's airport puts most of the region's courses within a 30–45 minute transfer, which keeps golf trips here compact even when a package covers several different courses over the week.

Climate & Best Time to Visit

Over 300 days of sunshine a year and mild winters make the Algarve playable nearly year-round, with spring and autumn the most popular windows to avoid summer heat.
